description: This file defines the JsonParser class, which implements standard JSON parsing logic for the AWS SDK for PHP. It handles parsing of various AWS API data shapes, such as structures, lists, maps, timestamps, and blobs.

classes.name: JsonParser
classes.description: Implements JSON parsing for AWS API responses.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a given value according to its defined AWS Shape, handling different data types like structure, list, map, timestamp, and blob.
